annotations.title: Get found: turn recruiter visibility on/off

description: Make one of the user's CVs findable by verified recruiters on TakeMeUp, or hide it again. Recruiters see the CV without contact details until the user approves them. Free. Only with the user's explicit agreement.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

enabled.description: true = findable by verified recruiters, false = hidden.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: set_takemeup_get_found
title: Get found: turn recruiter visibility on/off
